clinic_profile.tagline: Personalized physiotherapy, pain relief and rehabilitation care
clinic_profile.short_description: A physiotherapy clinic offering assessment, pain management, injury rehabilitation, post-surgery rehab, sports rehab, home physiotherapy and preventive care.

registration_and_compliance.prescription_required_for_physiotherapy: Not always required, but may be requested for post-surgical, neurological, fracture, cardiac or high-risk cases.

contact_channels.emergency_contact_policy: This clinic is not an emergency medical facility. For emergencies, customers should contact local emergency services or visit the nearest hospital.

services.name: Initial Physiotherapy Assessment
services.description: Detailed evaluation of pain, mobility, strength, posture, function, medical history and treatment goals.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this if the customer is unsure which service is right or is visiting for the first time.

services.name: Orthopedic Physiotherapy
services.description: Treatment for muscle, joint, ligament, tendon and spine-related pain or movement problems.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this for common pain, stiffness, sprain, strain, posture-related discomfort or joint movement restriction.

services.name: Sports Injury Rehabilitation
services.description: Rehabilitation for athletes and active individuals recovering from sports injuries or performance-limiting pain.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this if the customer plays sports, goes to the gym, runs, cycles, dances or wants to return to activity safely.

services.name: Post-Surgical Rehabilitation
services.description: Structured rehab after orthopedic or neurological surgery, based on surgeon clearance and healing stage.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this after surgery when the doctor has advised physiotherapy or movement rehabilitation.

services.name: Neurological Rehabilitation
services.description: Rehab for patients with movement, balance, coordination or functional limitations due to neurological conditions.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this for stroke, paralysis, nerve-related weakness, balance issues or neurological movement problems.

services.name: Geriatric Physiotherapy
services.description: Physiotherapy for older adults focused on mobility, balance, strength, fall prevention and independence.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this for elderly patients needing safe movement, strength, balance or walking support.

services.name: Women's Health Physiotherapy
services.description: Physiotherapy support for pregnancy, postpartum recovery, pelvic floor health and pain management.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this for pregnancy, postpartum or pelvic-floor-related physiotherapy needs.

services.name: Pediatric Physiotherapy
services.description: Physiotherapy for children with developmental, posture, movement or injury-related needs.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this for children needing movement, posture, developmental or injury rehabilitation support.

services.name: Posture and Ergonomics Consultation
services.description: Workstation, posture and lifestyle assessment for people with desk-job pain or repetitive strain.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this for office workers, remote workers, students or people with posture-related pain.

services.name: Pain Management Physiotherapy
services.description: Physiotherapy for acute or chronic pain using movement therapy, education, manual therapy and modalities where appropriate.
services.customer_choice_guidance: Choose this when the main goal is reducing pain and improving daily function.

pricing.invoice_policy: Invoice can be provided after payment.
pricing.refund_policy_summary: Refunds depend on cancellation timing, unused package sessions and clinic policy.

rescheduling_policy.notes: Late rescheduling may be treated as cancellation depending on clinic policy.

booking.no_show_policy: No-show appointments may be charged or deducted from package sessions.

clinical_intake_questions.question: Where is the pain or discomfort?
How long have you had this issue?
On a scale of 0 to 10, how severe is the pain?
Was this due to an injury, accident or surgery?
Have you consulted a doctor for this?
Do you have any X-ray, MRI, blood report, discharge summary or prescription?
What activity is difficult right now?

triage_and_safety.bot_role: The bot can collect information, explain clinic services, help with booking and suggest the most relevant physiotherapy service category. The bot must not diagnose medical conditions.
red_flags_requiring_urgent_medical_refer: sudden weakness on one side of body
new loss of bladder or bowel control
numbness in private area or saddle region
high fever with severe back or neck pain
unexplained weight loss with persistent pain
severe night pain not relieved by rest
post-surgery wound redness, pus, bleeding or fever
triage_and_safety.red_flag_bot_response: Your symptoms may need urgent medical attention. Please visit the nearest hospital, emergency department or contact local emergency services immediately. Physiotherapy booking can be considered after medical clearance.

pain_severity_guidance.0_3: Mild pain. Customer may book assessment or consultation.
pain_severity_guidance.4_6: Moderate pain. Recommend assessment before treatment plan.
pain_severity_guidance.7_10: Severe pain. Screen for red flags and recommend doctor consultation if sudden, traumatic or worsening.

choose_clinic_visit_when: sports or post-surgery rehab requires supervision
choose_home_visit_when: neurological rehab is needed at home
choose_online_consultation_when: customer needs posture or ergonomic advice
pain is mild and no red flags are present
decision_support.first_time_customer_recommendation: Recommend Initial Physiotherapy Assessment unless the customer clearly knows the required service.

patient_journey.step_1: Customer shares symptoms, pain area, duration and preferred mode.
patient_journey.step_2: Bot checks for red flags and doctor-clearance requirements.
patient_journey.step_3: Bot recommends suitable service category and appointment type.
patient_journey.step_4: Customer selects date, time, location and therapist preference if available.
patient_journey.step_5: Clinic confirms appointment and payment requirement.
patient_journey.step_6: Physiotherapist performs assessment and creates treatment plan.
patient_journey.step_7: Customer receives exercises, follow-up plan and package recommendation if needed.

documents_to_bring: X-ray, MRI, CT scan or ultrasound report if available

policies.privacy_policy: Customer data is used for appointment booking, clinical coordination, treatment records and communication. Data should not be shared externally without consent unless required by law or medical emergency.
policies.consent_policy: Customer consent is required before physical assessment, manual therapy, dry needling, cupping, taping, photographs or sharing medical records.
policies.minor_policy: Patients below 18 years should be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
policies.late_arrival_policy: Late arrival may reduce treatment time or require rescheduling.
policies.package_validity_policy: Package sessions must be used within the stated validity period.
policies.female_patient_policy: Female patients may request a female therapist if available.
policies.home_visit_policy: Home visits depend on therapist availability, service area, travel time and safety conditions.
policies.infection_control_policy: Treatment areas and equipment are cleaned regularly. Customers with fever or contagious illness should inform the clinic before visiting.

primary_bot_goals: help customers choose the right service
route complex cases to clinic staff
bot_must_not_do: must not provide a medical diagnosis
must not guarantee cure or recovery timeline
must not advise stopping prescribed medicines
must not handle emergencies as physiotherapy cases
must not claim insurance approval unless confirmed
must not confirm appointment unless slot availability is verified
handoff_to_human_when: customer is post-surgery and protocol is unclear
customer asks for therapist not listed

faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's prescription for physiotherapy?
faqs.answer: For common pain or posture issues, a prescription may not always be required. For post-surgery, fracture, neurological, cardiac, pregnancy-related or high-risk cases, medical clearance or documents may be needed.

faqs.question: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.answer: The number of sessions depends on the condition, severity, duration, age, activity level and treatment goals. The physiotherapist can suggest a plan after assessment.

faqs.question: Is home physiotherapy available?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the clinic offers home visits in the customer's area and a therapist is available.

faqs.question: Can I book physiotherapy for back pain?
faqs.answer: Yes. The bot should collect pain duration, severity, leg symptoms, injury history and red flags before booking.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Wear comfortable clothes that allow movement and allow the therapist to assess the affected area appropriately.

faqs.question: Is online physiotherapy effective?
faqs.answer: Online consultation can help with exercise guidance, posture correction and follow-ups, but it is not ideal when hands-on assessment or urgent medical care is needed.

faqs.question: Do you provide invoices?
faqs.answer: Yes, invoices can be provided if enabled by the clinic.

disclaimers.medical_disclaimer: Information shared by the bot is for clinic service guidance and appointment support only. It is not a medical diagnosis or emergency advice.
disclaimers.emergency_disclaimer: For severe or emergency symptoms, customers should seek urgent medical care from a hospital or emergency service.
disclaimers.outcome_disclaimer: Recovery time and results vary by individual condition, severity, consistency and medical factors.
